literal_meaning: হাতে ধরা হাঁড়ি (pot held in hand)
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার হাতে হাঁড়ি হয়েছে, এখন সে পরিবারের সদস্য।
বিয়ের পর হাতে হাঁড়ি নিয়ে নতুন জীবন শুরু করল।
example_sentences_in_english: He has the pot in hand now, meaning he's part of the family after marriage.
After the wedding, she started her new life with the pot in hand.
history: This idiom originates from traditional Bengali wedding rituals where the bride is symbolically associated with household items like a pot, signifying her entry into marital duties.
note: The idiom reflects rural Bengali customs of marriage preparations.
